scenario.summary: Searches a bundle product by SKU and verifies its Free Shipping, WaterSense and BIO Certified highlight badges and the '+N' remaining highlights count on the PLP, then opens the BIO Certified highlight page.
steps: Verify Free Shipping, WaterSense and BIO Certified badges
Click the BIO Certified badge, verify the Back to product link
assertions: Remaining highlights count equals the sheet value
evidence: DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): verifyWishListFunctionalityForRetailUser signs in with loginPage.customerSuccessfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/productListingPageTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B179/C179) and the later methods of the class (priority 100-125) run in that signed-in session until productListingPageLoggOffTheUser. Convention: every method that signs in or reuses the signed-in session declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true} (Tda.declareUser -> useExisting). Username/password stay credential sources (masked); the scanner recorded them only on the sign-in method, later methods declare the same two cells from the test source (the session they reuse).

product = PRODUCT_WITH_HIGHLIGHTS {productType bundle, highlight1Code BIOCertified, highlight2Code WaterSenseCertified, highlight3Code FreeShipping, store}; preferred the sheet SKU productDisplayPage!C336 z-1234579, not required. Runs in the signed-in session of verifyWishListFunctionalityForRetailUser (declares the account, see DECLARED ACCOUNT).

The badges are fixed locators (Free Shipping, WaterSense, BIO Certified): highlight3Code FreeShipping (optional param added 2026-11-10, user decision; ZnodeHighlight 5, active). The sheet's RemainingHighlightsCount '1' is product.remainingHighlightCount (new output: active highlights of the product minus the 3 badges the PLP shows).
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
